rules.title: Rules
rules.none: No rules yet: everything can be played at any time.
rules.name: Name
rules.pickScope: Pick at least one group, or all groups.
rules.countAfterHelp: A file only uses up one of the day's files after it has played this long today, so a quick tap doesn't count. 0 = counts at start.
rules.replayHelp: A counted file may play this much today in total, e.g. 120 % of a 30-min episode is 36 min. Then it is done for the day. Empty = unlimited replays.
rules.gemCostHelp: A new file needs this many gems. They are spent once it has played as long as "Counts after"; then it may be replayed today within the replay limit. Tomorrow it costs gems again. Empty = no gems needed.
rules.lockoutHelp: A window like 19:30–07:00 runs overnight and belongs to the evening's day.

rewards.intro: Stars come from finished off-screen ideas. Your child can swap them for a little more media time or ask for a wish.

rewards.wishesHelp: Things your child can ask for. You approve or decline each request here.

ideas.intro: Story worlds with something to draw, calculate, write and read. The tablet shows one chapter per activity day.

ideas.whenHelp: The story only moves on these days. Missed chapters can be caught up.
ideas.noDays: No activity days: the tablet hides the activities.

ideas.queueHelp: A world takes one activity day per chapter. The next one starts the day after.
